step_4_life_story_and_interests.occupation: Retired Presbyterian High School Principal & Community Educator

key_life_events.event: Appointed Principal of Aizawl High School

step_4_life_story_and_interests.favorite_music_or_artists: Mizo gospel songs, traditional Lengzem acoustic music, choral anthems.
step_4_life_story_and_interests.cultural_background: Mizo culture; celebrates Chapchar Kut and Christmas; loves wearing traditional Puan textile skirts.
step_4_life_story_and_interests.what_brings_them_joy: Looking out at the mist-covered Aizawl hills from her balcony, reading devotional poetry, and teaching granddaughter Mizo songs.
